name: HubTwoFactorVerify
description: Two-step check at sign-in, after the password. The page is AuthLayout (S63), like HubSignIn. The code is asked at every sign-in with the password (S59); locked after 5 wrong codes, for 15 minutes (S61). Shown at 1280 and 390, in light and dark; texts from `i18n/two-factor.json`.
states: Cod de rezervă (după „Folosește un cod de rezervă”)
